title: Preserve sampled SDL trigger state when loading a gamepad mapping
goal: Repair the actual pinned SDL mapping initialization defect discovered by MW3-089: opening a gamepad overwrites an already observed held trigger with its rest value. Produce a separate verified private SDL profile without changing existing SDKs or manufacturing controller input.
acceptance: Bind exact SDL submodule source/version, relevant joystick and gamepad declarations, original/derived source hashes, zlib notices and tool/config identities; reproduce the retained actual-library trigger reset before repair

Keep the trigger rest point for recentering and unknown initial state, while preserving an already sampled axis value during gamepad mapping initialization; inspect initialized/uninitialized axis semantics and change no guest or SDK provider API

Build and package the reviewed SDL derivative in private isolated source/output/profile directories on native Windows/Linux with supported participating-library sanitizer coverage; never modify shared sources, existing SDKs, user content or another lane's processes

Use original actual-SDL virtual-device tests for held trigger opening, unchanged polling, centered/unheld state, multiple consumers, reopen/remap and independent controls, with balanced owned cleanup and exact loaded-library identities; preserve baseline failures and meaningful result/partial/deadline controls

Publish a strict profile/preparation verifier and public evidence summary with exact hashes and explicit native-third-party, sanitizer, physical-hardware and title limitations; this opt-in profile does not change runtime selection or pass physical MW3-083 or guest input gates
validation: Run repeated native Windows/Linux profile tests and supported host/participating SDL ASan/UBSan coverage; distinguish ordinary repaired passes, original baseline failure, invalid controls and incomplete evidence
Validate patch/source/tool/library/package/receipt mutation rejection and output isolation with public game-free guards; run python tools/check.py and relevant platform checks

Review source provenance, retained notices, diagnostic behavior and exact reviewed head; keep SDK/game binaries, raw logs and generated build output private and record self-review if no independent reviewer is available
size: bounded opt-in SDL mapping repair/profile; physical hardware and translated-title adoption remain independent
